name.zh: Thalassinoides 开放Y节点潜穴结构剖面

description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: smooth stout tunnels connect through open y-shaped junctions. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants. Display convention: sectional-structure; section cuts are illustrative, not an excavated specimen claim.
description.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：粗平滑隧道通过开阔Y形节点相连。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。 表现方式：结构剖面；剖切是示意，不声称复制出土标本。

reconstruction_notes.en: Trace-concept artistic teaching section: continuous gray host-rock block with a unioned network of stout smooth negative tunnel cavities, two open Y junctions and section-edge outlets. The upper section plane removes the roof to expose the cavity/host relationship; dark inner surfaces are original gray palette, not floating branches, worms or filled casts. Nominal 0.32 m block width, path layout and section convention are art choices. No producer species, exact trace dimensions, behavior, excavated specimen or locality asserted.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 遗迹概念艺术教学剖面：连续灰色围岩块内有经合并的粗平滑负空间隧道、两处开放Y节点与剖面边缘出口。上部剖切平面移去顶壁以显露洞腔与围岩关系；深灰内表面为原创配色，不是悬空枝条、虫体或实体充填铸型。0.32米名义块宽、路径布局与剖切方式为美术设定。不指定制造者物种、精确遗迹尺寸、行为、出土标本或地点。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
